sourceLineage.origin: SQM official investor relations Mt Holland expansion FID

observations: SQM and Wesfarmers announced a final investment decision on July 21, 2026 for expansion of the Mt Holland lithium project.
risks: new lithium capacity can amplify commodity-cycle exposure if demand/pricing disappoints
single release does not establish project economics, schedule or funding burden
unknowns: project capex and SQM funding share
expected cost curve position and lithium-price assumptions

recommendation.reason: Primary FID is a material execution signal, but underwriting still requires project economics and current operating results.
